row.evidence: ZoomInfo's help centre documents SCIM provisioning for Chorus through the Okta app (push new users, profile updates, deactivation and reactivation), which Chorus Support must activate; Chorus pricing is "custom plans" via Get Pricing only.
row.notes: Quote-only: Chorus (now sold as ZoomInfo Chorus; chorus.ai redirects to zoominfo.com) publishes no plans or prices, so SCIM can only be bought through sales. SCIM is documented only for Okta: the Okta OIN app (marked SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate; Group Push unchecked) uses an org-specific API token that Chorus Support issues and Support must switch the feature on. Okta deactivation keeps the user as an inactive user with data retained; permanent deletion needs Support. No generic SCIM endpoint, Entra, Google, OneLogin or JumpCloud provisioning is documented, but since the plan gate is Contact Sales the row is gated, not partial (price gate first); the IdP restriction is recorded in idp. Admins can also bulk add, update and deactivate users by CSV import. The public Chorus API (early access, token via CSM) only reads users and teams.

plans.name: Custom plan
plans.notes: ZoomInfo lists Chorus only as custom plans; no tiers published.

auth.token_source: Org-specific API token issued by Chorus Support (support@chorus.ai / chorussupport@zoominfo.com), entered in the Okta app's API integration

operations.notes: Okta 'Push Profile Updates' is documented; whether it uses PUT or PATCH is not. Group Push is unchecked on the OIN page (markup). Delete is not done by provisioning; permanent deletion needs Support.

deprovision.data_retained: User loses login access but their Chorus information stays as an inactive user; permanent deletion of user data requires Chorus Support.

custom.how: Okta app attributes Chorus Role and Chorus License Type (required on assignment) and manager_email (sets the user's manager and team)

roles.how: Chorus Role and Chorus License Type app attributes selected when assigning users or groups in Okta

limitations.text: Documented for Okta only; no generic SCIM endpoint or other IdP is documented.
Provisioning must be activated by Chorus Support, which issues the API token.
Username and email address changes are not supported.
The help article says the SCIM integration requires a higher tier version of Okta.

auth.notes: Per-user API token in the Authorization header; the user's role must be allowed Chorus API access. During early access the token comes from the customer success manager.

limitations.text: The API only reads users and teams; no user create, update or deactivate endpoints are documented.

okta.notes: OIN page markup marks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate as checked; Group Push unchecked. built_by from 'Chorus's Okta app'.
